game.desc: In Eat Lead: The Return of Matt Hazard for Xbox 360, you play as Matt Hazard, a video game hero whose creator is trying to get rid of him by locking him in his own game. Parodying the world of video games, Eat Lead is a third-person shooter full of references to many great titles.
